verdicts.reason: Both carry over the vertical line breaks as 'CONS TRUC TION', which reads as three broken words on one line. Both cram the brick, 'Buy 2 only for', a tiny ORDER NOW button and the $14.99 price into the right third, so the price comes after the CTA and is too small to stand out. A's larger brick butts right up against 'Buy 2'. B's slightly smaller brick leaves a hair more clearance, but otherwise the two are almost identical.
